name: Jack Lester
source:
A care-free traveler.

Like the protagonist, this traveler is visiting the island by chance.
Normally a detective for the Yard, they have come to Mirage for a vacation.

Despite being a detective, he has a somewhat laid-back and approachable demeanor.
He seems lazy, but he also has a brotherly side and is very caring.
